parameters.name: BlockedSTA
parameters.description: MAC addresses of the STA that is blocked.

parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates BSS from which the {{param|BlockedSTA}} is blocked from association and cannot associate to. A null list indicates that all SSIDs are blocked.

object.description: This object indicates stations (STAs) for which client association is blocked. optionally the BSSID(s) the STA is blocked from associating to. In multi-AP cases, this should be implemented by Wi-Fi EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} client association control. Stations that are already associated shall be disassociated if {{object|#.STABlock.{i}.Schedule.{i}.}} indicates so.
